file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) console executable, MinGW-w64 GCC 13, not stripped (contains DWARF debug info; source file windows_level20_RemotePEExecution.c)

injection_details.method: Remote PE injection (RunPE-style): OpenProcess(0x43A = PROCESS_VM_OPERATION|PROCESS_VM_WRITE|PROCESS_VM_READ|PROCESS_CREATE_THREAD|PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION) -> VirtualAllocEx(MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE, SizeOfImage) -> NtWriteVirtualMemory of PE headers (SizeOfHeaders) and each section (PointerToRawData -> VirtualAddress) -> manual base-relocation fixups for IMAGE_REL_BASED_DIR64 entries (ReadProcessMemory 8 bytes, add delta = remoteBase - ImageBase, NtWriteVirtualMemory back) -> CreateRemoteThread with lpStartAddress = remoteBase + AddressOfEntryPoint and lpParameter = remoteBase -> WaitForSingleObject(hThread, 10000) -> CloseHandle/NtClose
injection_details.target_discovery: CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS) + Process32First/Process32Next, strcmp(szExeFile, "explorer.exe"); falls back to GetCurrentProcessId() (self-injection) if explorer.exe not found
injection_details.payload_write: 64-byte RC4-encrypted PE at g_encrypted_pe (.data 0x140004000) decrypted in-memory with RC4 key g_rc4_key, then written into the remote process via NtWriteVirtualMemory (resolved at runtime from ntdll.dll via GetModuleHandleA+GetProcAddress); NtClose used instead of CloseHandle for the process handle

encryption_details.algorithm: RC4 (custom rc4_init KSA / rc4_crypt PRGA implementation)
encryption_details.key: R3m0t3_PE_3x3c_K (16 bytes ASCII, key length 0x10 passed to rc4_init)
encryption_details.key_storage: Hardcoded global g_rc4_key in .rdata at VA 0x140005000; the 16 key bytes are immediately followed by "ntdll.dll", together forming the leetspeak decoy string "R3m0t3_PE_3x3c_Kntdll.dll" (GetModuleHandleA is called with offset +0x10 so it reads "ntdll.dll")

decoded_strings.note: The 64-byte blob at g_encrypted_pe (7de35a8c1fb446d92e81f73b65ca0892...) is an RC4-encrypted PE image (runtime code validates MZ/PE magic and reads SizeOfImage/AddressOfEntryPoint before injection); it decrypts in memory and is never written to disk

anti_analysis: anti_sandbox_check: GetModuleHandleA("sbiedll.dll") detects Sandboxie; if present WinMain calls Sleep(30000) and exits without injecting
secondary check: GetModuleHandleA("dbghelp.dll") + GetProcAddress("SymSetOptions") (decoy/AV-analysis detection stub)
time-based evasion: Sleep(30000) on sandbox detection; Sleep(2000) after injection
resolves NtWriteVirtualMemory/NtClose from ntdll at runtime instead of importing WriteProcessMemory (API-hook/EDR evasion); import table stays minimal
